Types of kurtis every woman should know!
Straight cut. Clean and simple. Goes with everything.
A-line. Fitted on top, flares gently at the bottom.
Empire. The seam sits just under the bust, then flows down.
Kaftan. Loose, breezy, and so comfortable.
Shirt style. A collar and buttons. Smart for office.
High-low. Short in front, long at the back.
Front slit. One long slit in the front. Very chic.
Peplum. Fitted at the waist, with a flare at the hips.
Asymmetric. A slanting hem, full of style.
And the royal one... the Kalidar! Many panels, full of grace.
